mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading designates the entire area of the diamond-shaped quadrilateral. Right image: The shading highlights the angle from the rightward reference direction down to OA.
Rationales: The feature selects a geometric area in the left image and highlights the angle between two rays in the right image. The blue interior of the diamond divided by two magenta diagonals. The cyan wedge next to 28° at O.
